description: Verifies the MOND framework: the Newtonian limit at high acceleration, the deep-MOND limit at low acceleration, the asymptotically flat rotation velocity of a point mass, the baryonic Tully-Fisher relation v^4 = G M a0, and the simple interpolation function.

checks.label: at high acceleration the MOND acceleration equals the Newtonian value within 1 percent
at low acceleration the MOND acceleration follows sqrt(a_N a0) within 5 percent

checks.section: Rotation curve of a point mass
checks.label: the circular velocity at 30 kpc is within 5 percent of the flat value

checks.section: Rotation curve of a point mass
checks.label: the circular velocity at 50 kpc is within 3 percent of the flat value

checks.section: Rotation curve of a point mass

the simple interpolation reaches the flat velocity within 5 percent at 100 kpc
